purpose: Frozen exploratory paired revision of 3D curve objectives; all MAG/PHA retained; no website publication

integral.edge_distance: trapezoid of full normalized 3D squared link distance
integral.normalization: fixed target window span, never path point count

selection.primary: MAG_plus_alpha_PHA over final retained population, no auxiliary score
selection.secondary: common original max Frechet score within paired baseline MAG/PHA allowance

success_scope: Independent structure, local phase, other events and global MAG/PHA; aux score reduction alone never defines success; all four targets development data, four seeds exploratory; compare mean vs max and chord vs mean to separate changes
cpu_policy: 32 allocated CPUs; BLAS threads 1 per worker; measure cgroup CPU consumption during useful computation; do not launch dummy work to inflate utilization; tail and IO may use less CPU
budget_policy: No post-result tuning, extra seeds or website upload; fixed definitions, hashes, paired initializations, operators and budgets; final population rules do not guarantee globally optimal parameters
